scope: read-only local Codex config allowlist and one wsl --status check

limits: No auth, token, custom instruction, environment, or MCP values were read or emitted.
A configured model value does not prove which model served a particular chat.
The current task runtime permission profile is supplied by the host and is not inferred from config.toml.

wsl.interpretation: WSL2 is installed/configured. This status check does not prove a distro is currently running or that this repo is inside WSL.

recommendation: Use native Windows by default for this Windows-based Codex workflow. Use WSL2 only if a task needs Linux-native tooling, the repo/developer workflow is already in WSL2, or native sandbox implementations do not meet the need. No WSL dependency is established for cloud-hosted Codex work or a separate Linux VPS.
